src: ; 16 matmul_cached — the same matrix multiply, on a GPU with a 16-line cache
; Identical instructions to 07_matmul. The only change is .cache 16: a small
; direct-mapped cache (rtl/ps_cache.v) sits between the memory arbiter and
; DRAM. Every row of A and column of B is read by many threads, so most loads
; hit the cache and never reach DRAM. Compare the cycle counts:
; A streaming kernel (13_gradient_shader) gets slightly slower with the same
; cache: with no reuse, every access pays for the extra hop. That trade-off is
; why real GPUs let programs choose how to use their caches.
MAD   R3, R0, R1, R2        ; i
MAD   R8, R10, R11, R8      ; acc += a * b
